lang: python
file: models.py
---
class Metric(models.Model):
    tenant_id = models.IntegerField()
    timestamp = models.DateTimeField()
    class Meta:
        indexes = [models.Index(fields=["tenant_id", "timestamp"])]

def read(cutoff):
    return Metric.objects.filter(tenant_id=1, timestamp__gte=cutoff)
